title: Network dynamics of momentary affect states and future course of psychopathology in adolescents
limitations: - Sample limited to twin cohort, limiting generalizability; - Sample predominantly Caucasian; - Only two time points for psychopathology assessment; - Group definitions based on arbitrary thresholds; - Network analysis at group level, not individual level.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether it was preregistered. The code is declared available in the supplementary materials, but the dataset is not publicly available due to privacy concerns under European law.
